@deskSetFrameTransactions.description: Settings sidebar entry and page name for how payments are made: the methods, what Send starts on, receiving. Narrow (about 200 px).

@deskSetTxMethods.description: Title of the page’s first part on Settings › Transactions: one group per family (Epicbox, Link, Direct) with a switch per method.

deskSetTxEpicboxHint: Pay and get paid through an Epicbox server. Most payments go this way. Off, the wallet connects to no Epicbox server: no Epicbox payments or invoices. The other methods still work.

@deskSetTxEpicboxHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Epicbox row on Settings › Transactions.

deskSetTxDirectHint: Pay and get paid straight from wallet to wallet at a web address (http://host:{port}), with no server between. Works only while both wallets are open; off while Tor is on. Adds Link · HTTP to Send and its address to Receive.

@deskSetTxDirectHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Link › HTTP row (switch) on Settings › Transactions.

deskSetTxFileHint: Pay and get paid by handing over a transaction file, with no network needed. Adds File Transfer to Send and the file steps to Receive.

@deskSetTxFileHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the File row (switch) on Settings › Transactions.

@deskSetTxSend.description: Title of the group on Settings › Transactions with what the Send page starts on and, with Advanced › Send options on, its defaults.

@deskSetTxStart.description: Row title on Settings › Transactions: the payment method the Send page opens with. The control lists the methods that are on.

deskSetTxStartHint: The method the Send page opens with. You can still change it for one payment on Send.

@deskSetTxStartHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Send starts on row.

deskSetTxTorHint: Pay and get paid straight from wallet to wallet at an onion address, over Tor, with no server between. Works only while both wallets are open. Needs Tor: the Tor switch under Privacy routes the wallet’s connections through Tor; this switch only turns the address on. Adds Link · Tor to Send and its address to Receive.

@deskSetTxTorHint.description: Hover card behind the info icon of the Link › Tor row (switch) on Settings › Transactions.

deskSetTxTorNeedsTor: Tor is off. Turn it on under Privacy to be paid at the Tor address.

@deskSetTxTorNeedsTor.description: Notice under the Link › Tor switch on Settings › Transactions while it is on and Tor (Settings › Privacy) is off; the button beside it opens Privacy.

deskSetTxLastMethod: Keep at least one payment method on.

@deskSetTxLastMethod.description: Toast when the last payment method that is on is switched off on Settings › Transactions: the switch stays on.
